items.title: Big Oil Puts Debt Reduction Ahead of New Investments
items.summary: Despite record profits, oil majors are prioritizing debt reduction, share buybacks and financial discipline rather than launching major new investment programs.

items.title: Trump Says Iran “Wants a Settlement.” CEO Predicts Peace Sends Oil 40% Lower for Exxon, Chevron
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBrent crude fell 8% on Nov. 2 after Iran signaled it was open to peace talks and President Trump posted that Iran wants a settlement.

items.title: The U.S. Has Been Striking Iran as Trump Talks Up a Deal
items.summary: Trump posted that oil was crashing because Iran wants peace, then US officials said American jets had just struck Iranian territory. The two stories cannot both be true, and oil traders are now betting on which one to believe.

items.title: Chevron Maintains 2028 Data Center Power Target Despite Texas Pause
